einzeiler: Week 2 lineup advice, start-sit debates, and touchdown calls
kurzfassung: Ryan Wormeli, Pat Fitzmaurice, and Jake Ciely discuss Week 2 fantasy football lineup decisions. They evaluate waiver-wire pickups and analyze specific player comparisons. The episode also covers touchdown predictions and borderline roster choices.
stichpunkte: Evaluating waiver-wire additions for starting lineups
Borderline running back, wide receiver, FLEX, quarterback, and tight end decisions
beschreibung:
Week 2 lineup decisions are already getting uncomfortable. Ryan Wormeli, Pat Fitzmaurice, and Jake Ciely break down which waiver-wire pickups can go straight into your starting lineup and identify the players they’re willing to bet on despite consensus.
The crew tackles some of the week’s toughest calls, including Aaron Jones vs. Chuba Hubbard, Drake London’s shaky quarterback situation, and whether Jalen Coker, Parker Washington, and Quentin Johnston belong in lineups. They also sort through borderline RB, WR, FLEX, QB, and TE decisions using matchup, role, and ECR.
Plus, get their Week 2 touchdown calls and final lineup advice before your lineups lock.
